metadata.title: Retro Pop Portrait with Diagonal Graphic

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot studio portrait of a smiling male figure in 1970s attire, set against a dark, moody background with a prominent, stylized diagonal text element in the upper left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically with a slight lean to the right
Diagonal text element counterbalancing the subject's posture
High contrast between white clothing and dark background
Warm, directional lighting creating soft shadows on the face
coreInvariants: Argyle pattern vest in red and black
White dress shirt with a white bow tie
Green diagonal graphic bar behind the main text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the central two-thirds of the frame, from waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and bright white bow tie.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the diagonal text in the top left, follows the angle down to the subject's face, then down the white shirt sleeves.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep brown/black negative space surrounds the subject, emphasizing the studio lighting effect.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep brown and black background for mood and depth.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white in the shirt, pants, and bow tie for high visibility.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Kelly green in the graphic element and red in the argyle pattern.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the background with high value contrast in the subject's clothing.

letterConstructionRules: Letters are slanted at a 45-degree angle
Strokes are of uniform thickness with rounded ends
Horizontal 'speed lines' or striations cut through the letters
White fill with a thick green drop shadow/extrusion
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are integrated into a thick green diagonal banner
The 'D' has a large open counter
The 'Y' has a long, straight descender following the diagonal axis
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant custom graphic; no secondary text.
graphicDevices: Diagonal green bar with white border lines

candidateDirections.reason: To capture the specific slanted, striated look

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a man with dark 70s hair, wearing a white shirt, white bow tie, and a red/black argyle vest, standing against a dark brown gradient background with warm lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large diagonal text element in the top left corner at a 45-degree angle. The text should be white with horizontal lines through it, sitting on a thick green 3D extruded bar.

verificationChecks: Is the text angled exactly at 45 degrees?
Does the argyle pattern use red and black diamonds?
Is the lighting soft and warm on the subject's face?
Is the green color a vibrant Kelly green?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any brand logos in the corners

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp vector graphic for the text

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white bow tie is a focal point
Check that the green diagonal does not touch the subject
Verify the 70s hair volume is maintained
Confirm the background is a dark, warm gradient
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a warm-toned 70s studio portrait with a bold, 45-degree diagonal graphic element in the upper quadrant to create a retro pop aesthetic.
